skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — generate a 30-second promotional video from these images and this script —...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Generator AB2N: generate promotional videos from images and text in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV uploads up to 500MB.
- Automatic cloud session setup with 100 free credits for new users.
- Simple workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinements.
- Includes status, credits, export, and timeline state checks via easy commands.
- Export videos in multiple formats, with AI handling video compositing and rendering.
